title: LLM Scout bellwether signals and procurement action plan
creator: Asha Patel
description:
Goal: Build a lightweight, prioritized signal pipeline (the 'Bellwether') that detects early signs of competitive model regressions, availability issues, or cost/latency arbitrage and converts them into deterministic procurement or fallback actions.

Scope:
- Define 8 bellwether signals (latency drift, per-token cost delta, availability/error-rate spike, eval-set quality drift, embedding-space shift, model-variant unavailability, quantization regression signal, third-party vendor announcements).
- Produce a composite Bellwether Score and triage thresholds (info / investigate / urgent-procurement).
- Wire signals into a console dashboard, Slack alerts, and an automated runbook that recommends procurement actions (open RFP, trigger reserved-capacity bid, enable fallback model variant, throttle noncritical routes).
- Provide acceptance criteria, data sources, and minimal viable alerting UX.

Out of scope for MVP: fully automated procurement (legal/finance approval required), on-prem installation flow, advanced ML-based anomaly detection.

Success metrics (MVP):
- Signal false positive rate < 20% on the first 6-week replay window
- Time from signal to recommended action < 10 minutes (systemic delays excluded)
- 3 documented use-cases where Bellwether prevented >5% latency/cost regression impact for customers

Notes on constraints and trade-offs:
- Priority for signals that are cheap to compute from existing telemetry (latency/cost/error-rate) to accelerate rollout.
- Quality drift detection will be based on a small stable eval set (50 prompts) to avoid heavy labeling. Expect higher noise but fast signal.
- Thresholds must be conservative at first and tuned after a 4-week signal calibration period.

Acceptance criteria:
- Defined schema and composite scoring algorithm in Confluence + example queries.
- Dashboard with top-5 active signals and per-model Bellwether Score.
- Runbook that maps score bands to specific procurement/fallback recommendations and owner contacts.
- Alerting integrated with Slack and tagged with suggested action and required approvals.
